summary: Phase 18 — BootStepper API integration + home overflow + custom auth hero — ALL GREEN. Backend: 17/17 pytest passed in /app/backend/tests/test_bootstepper.py. Verified: (a) GET /api/bootstepper/{search,popular,dances/{id}} require auth (401 unauthed) and return normalised items with attribution.provider='BootStepper'. Fields id/title/choreographer/url/count/wall/level/video_count all present. (b) POST /api/dances/from-bootstepper creates a fresh dance with bootstepper_ref set, bootstepper_url populated, and copperknob_ref/copperknob_url LEFT EMPTY; duplicate re-import returns 409 already_exists with existing_dance_id. Non-admin (regular user) gets 403. (c) POST /api/dances/{id}/link-bootstepper on a dance with copperknob_ref='FAKE123' correctly ADDS bootstepper_ref without wiping the CopperKnob ref. Non-admin gets 403. (d) The Phase 18 STICKY GUARD in routes/dances.py update_dance holds — a follow-up PUT that omits copperknob_ref AND bootstepper_ref preserves both refs from the existing doc. Verified via GET after PUT that both refs still equal 'FAKE123' and the linked BootStepper id. (e) GET /api/dances/{id}/bootstepper-compare returns fields[] with (field/ours/bootstepper/differs) and differs_count. Non-admin gets 403. (f) CopperKnob regression: /api/copperknob/search + /popular still return attribution.provider='CopperKnob'. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844, logged in as Erin admin): /auth hero renders new login-hero.jpg, 'Stompin' Ground / DANCE SOCIAL HQ' overlay text pinned to the TOP (top:12) with dark scrim — does NOT overlap the printed SGY logo (which sits at ~20-55% of the 520px hero). testID 'auth-hero-title' resolves to "Stompin' Ground". /bootstepper/search: back button, header 'Search BootStepper', attribution banner, search input all present. Typing 'Copperhead' returns cards with 'BootStepper' pill + 'Add to Library' + 'View on BootStepper' buttons. /bootstepper/popular renders Anak Sekolah (602 videos), Maria Merengue (601), Do It With Style (505) sorted by videoCount desc, with attribution and 'Already in Library' badge on the matched Love Potion 666. Library tab footer shows all four CTAs: 'Search CopperKnob', 'Search BootStepper', 'Popular on CopperKnob', 'Popular on BootStepper' (count=1 each). Dance detail /dance/{id} admin section shows the Step-Sheet card row with BOTH CopperKnob + BootStepper 'Search · long-press to pin direct link' entries stacked, PLUS the 'Link CopperKnob record' + 'Link BootStepper record' rows stacked below (7 refs each for CK/BS text on page). Attribution footer 'not affiliated with or endorsed by CopperKnob or BootStepper' renders. Home page 'Fresh on the Floor' + 'See all' both found (count=2 for See all across sections), 'Recently Practiced' + 'Pick up where you left off' both render on the same row (count=1 each) — no overflow observed on 390px viewport. Deprecated packages detected: NONE new. Pre-existing warnings still emit (see react_native_issues).

react_native_issues.issue: 'Unexpected text node: A text node cannot be a child of a <View>' emits multiple times per screen render. Root cause: /app/frontend/app/auth.tsx:162 has literal whitespace between JSX tags — `<SafeAreaView style=... edges={[...]}>      <KeyboardAvoidingView` — those spaces become a text child of the SafeAreaView (renders as View on web). Similar pattern may exist on other screens. Pre-existing from iteration 27/28. Reference: /app/frontend/app/auth.tsx:162.

Console still emits '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' and same for textShadow*. Present in auth.tsx (heroTitle/heroSubtitle textShadow* at :467-469, :478-480) and widespread across theme. RN 0.76+ deprecates these. Pre-existing, non-blocking. Reference: /app/frontend/app/auth.tsx:467-469.

Console warns 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — /app/frontend/app/auth.tsx:196 uses `<View style={styles.heroTopContent} pointerEvents="none">`. Should be `style={[styles.heroTopContent, { pointerEvents: 'none' }]}`. Non-blocking.

action_items: Fix the stray whitespace in /app/frontend/app/auth.tsx line 162 — collapse `<SafeAreaView ...>      <KeyboardAvoidingView` onto separate lines with no space, or wrap children on next line. Same warning has now been seen in 3 consecutive iterations (27, 28, 29) and is polluting the console.
Move `pointerEvents="none"` from prop to `style` in auth.tsx:196 (and audit other screens for the same pattern).
Plan a sweep of shadow*/textShadow* → boxShadow/textShadow ahead of the next Expo SDK bump.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/dances.py:359-375 – The 'sticky guard' correctly iterates all four external ref fields (copperknob_ref, copperknob_url, bootstepper_ref, bootstepper_url) and falls back to the existing DB value when the incoming payload has empty/blank. Uses `.strip()` so whitespace-only strings also fall back — good.

routes/bootstepper.py:441-447 – link-bootstepper `$set` only mutates {bootstepper_ref, bootstepper_url, bootstepper_linked_at, bootstepper_linked_by}. NEVER touches copperknob_* fields. Verified end-to-end.
routes/bootstepper.py:88-142 – Duplicate detection order (ref → url regex → title+choreographer) is exactly the spec. Regex uses `re.escape` on both bs_id and title/choreographer — no ReDoS surface.
services/bootstepper.py:288-291 – get_by_id passes includeStepSheet=false + includeVideos=false — Terms-of-Use compliant. Route handlers never override.
services/bootstepper.py:73-85 – API key never returned to clients; sent server-side only via X-BootStepper-API-Key header.

routes/bootstepper.py:305-391 – from-bootstepper explicitly sets `copperknob_url:""` and `copperknob_ref:""` on new docs — good, but note this means a fresh import will WIPE any CK data if someone hand-edits the payload to include a matching CK ref. Not a real threat since only admins can call it, but worth a comment.
routes/bootstepper.py:427-439 – Cross-dance BootStepper id collision returns 409 id_already_used — protects against accidental split of one BootStepper record across two library rows.
